lockFileMaintenance.description: This package ships no dependencies and commits no lockfile (see .gitignore), so there is nothing to relock. The shared preset enables lockFileMaintenance with prPriority 10 for every consumer; left on here it heads the queue with a branch that can never produce a diff.

customManagers.description: The TypeScript version CI validates against is pinned inside a `run:` step, which no built-in manager parses. Without this the pin is invisible to Renovate and only moves when a human remembers.
matchStrings: # renovate: datasource=(?<datasource>\S+) depName=(?<depName>\S+)\s+run: npm install --no-save --no-package-lock typescript@(?<currentValue>\S+)

packageRules.description: Scoped automerge (decision 2026-08-01): devDependencies patch/minor merge themselves once checks are green. Majors stay human.
The CI TypeScript pin must satisfy the published `typescript >=5.5` peerDependency, so it stays human-reviewed: a major here is a statement about what consumers can compile with.
